llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must capture scroll offset with Reanimated `useAnimatedScrollHandler(...)` attached to `Animated.ScrollView onScroll`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: scrollHandler is created with useAnimatedScrollHandler but is attached to a plain React Native `ScrollView`, not `Animated.ScrollView`. Reanimated requires `Animated.ScrollView` (from react-native-reanimated) for the animated scroll handler to work correctly.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compute header visuals in `useAnimatedStyle` using `interpolate(...)` from the shared scroll value (for example height and/or opacity).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedStyle computes header height and title opacity/translateY using interpolate(...) from the shared scrollY value.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Interpolation for header collapse must use clamped extrapolation (`Extrapolation.CLAMP`) with explicit input/output ranges.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Clamped extrapolation is applied with explicit input/output ranges, but uses the deprecated `Extrapolate.CLAMP` enum (imported as `Extrapolate`) rather than the required `Extrapolation.CLAMP` from react-native-reanimated v3+/v4. The import confirms `Extrapolate` not `Extrapolation` is used.
evidence: Extrapolate.CLAMP (used in all interpolate calls, not Extrapolation.CLAMP)
